name: Crazy Squares: Milk River Run
summary:
Hop on your spoon and surf your Crazy Square along an infinite river of milk, dodging obstacles, hitting high-flying jumps and gaining Power Ups —always just out of reach of a giant, hungry Crazy Square!  

The object of the game is to have a smooth run and have fun (while licking and chomping Cinnamon Toast Crunch along the way). Power Ups will help move you faster. Any bumps, stumbles, licks or spills will slow you down. Just don’t let them slow you enough to get eaten!

Each level of Milk River Run lasts as long as you can (with a few breaks in between, of course). No two runs are alike. And the more you power up, the better the board! But if that’s not enough, take on the new levels waiting for you to unlock! Crazy Squares: Milk River Run is a high-energy, non-stop adventure that you can ask your parents to help download!
